name: @korri/shell-packages
description: Builds the surface packages' logic.js from their logic.ts (bun) and typechecks them. The packages themselves hold no node_modules.

scripts.zone:build: cd packages/zone && bun build logic.ts --outfile logic.js --format iife --target browser --minify
scripts.pico:build: cd packages/pico && bun build logic.ts --outfile logic.js --format iife --target browser --minify
scripts.velvet:build: cd packages/velvet && bun build logic.ts --outfile logic.js --format iife --target browser --minify
